hooks.prompt: If the conversation involved deploying the website (sahusuraj.com, website-deploy, push to main) OR the user said they cannot see updates on the site: return JSON with decision 'approve' and systemMessage: 'Remind the user: Site updates may take 1-2 minutes after push. If updates are not visible: (1) Hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) or open https://www.sahusuraj.com/cv/ in incognito, (2) Check deployment status: https://github.com/surajinacademia/website/actions.
